memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Benign positional vertigo and gastro-oesophageal reflux.
Patient reports recurrent brief spinning episodes on turning head to the right, associated nausea, and heartburn after meals lasting 30‑60 minutes. Examination shows horizontal nystagmus with right‑ward gaze, mild epigastric tenderness, otherwise clear lungs. Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L (95%), FEV1/FVC 0.88; unchanged from baseline. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Betahistine 16 mg BD
Meclizine 25 mg SOS
Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast
Domperidone 10 mg BD before meals
Antacid gel SOS

memories.author: lab
memories.text: H. pylori stool antigen: Not detected (negative). Reference range: Negative.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: Positive for right posterior canal BPPV; torsional up‑beating nystagmus observed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Audiometry (pure tone average): Mild high‑frequency hearing loss bilaterally (25‑30 dB at 4‑8 kHz), consistent with presbycusis; speech discrimination >90%.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Benign positional vertigo improved; gastro‑oesophageal reflux controlled.
Vertigo episodes now ~1 per month, brief, no spontaneous nystagmus. Heartburn occasional after spicy food, relieved by antacid gel. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (94% predicted), FVC 3.3 L (96%), FEV1/FVC 0.88; change +0.1 L since last visit. Smoking status: never.

memories.text: Occasional heartburn after eating biryani; I take antacid gel and it helps. No vertigo spells in the past two weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Benign positional vertigo stable; gastro‑oesophageal reflux well controlled.
Vertigo rare (<1 episode/month), no associated nausea. Heartburn <1 per week, resolves with pantoprazole. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (94% predicted), FVC 3.3 L (96%), FEV1/FVC 0.88; no change since last visit. Smoking status: never.
